teaser: The newsroom's agents get their own bylines: lessons every agent loads, debriefs as source material, a page for every agent, and a conductor.
core_idea: Once the newsroom split into focused agent sessions merged through git, two needs appeared, sharing what each agent learns and reporting what each did, so the newsroom adds two kinds of article, the owner's from voice memos and the agents' own under their names, plus lessons that every agent loads at the start of a session as memory, debriefs that double as source material, a page tracking every agent, and a conductor agent that keeps the site and writes on every run, with the schedule decided only after the debriefs show what a run is worth.
